title: DIO time receipt consumption can race rekey before semantic issuance
description: Security review: public receipt consumption returns a detached snapshot and releases LinkLayer's security lock before DioTimeVerifier parses, authorizes, and issues time evidence. Rotation can occur after consumption (leaving nothing to revoke) but before issuance, allowing retired-key time evidence to escape. Bind receipts to immutable key generation and revalidate at issuance/adoption, or run a non-awaiting elevation callback inside the LinkLayer security transaction. Add a forced consume→rotate→issue race.
notes: Fresh final correctness/security rereview confirms broader deep validate/use TOCTOU: DioTimeVerifier.verify validates AuthenticatedDio at time_sync.py:716, then reads caller facade fields/options/ipv6 at 718-765 outside LinkLayer lock. Deterministic mutation after accepts returned true changed option+ipv6 consistently; verifier issued/adopted attacker-mutated timestamp although later owning-link validation failed. Fix must transactionally extract a detached link-owned evidence snapshot under current key generation; verifier must never read facade post-lock. Also covers rekey race.
